pages.note: Rebuilt 2026-09-15 around a showcase bar modeled on the Next.js and Expo showcases, which list only shipped products: a store listing plus at least 100 users across stores. Five public repositories that depend on Extension.js clear it, each verified by reading package.json (dependency on `extension` at 1.1.1 or later or a dist-tag, plus a script calling the CLI) and a manifest.json: better-lyrics/better-lyrics (^4.1.5; Chrome, Firefox, Edge; 100K+ users), StarCitizenToolBox/StarCitizenBoxBrowserEx (^2.0.0-rc.23; Chrome 1,000, Firefox 125, Edge 3,684), alex9849/chrome-simple-keyboard (^2.0.0-rc.23; Chrome 4,000), migteam/better-trello-browser-extension (latest; Chrome, Firefox; 1.1K), joaomagfreitas/send-to-pocket-book extension/ (latest; Chrome, Firefox; 290). Users come from the Firefox Add-ons API v5, the Edge getproductdetailsbycrxid endpoint and the Chrome Web Store page, floored to two significant digits. Store ids were checked against listing titles. Dropped below the bar: unpublished Opal Connect and Save to ADHX, the Apollo, dmMiniPlayer and ClaimeAI side packages, browser4agent (97 users), lexical-devtools (26), TidyTabs (4), cmd (6), Bookmrk (1). A unit test asserts every project on the page meets the bar.
Parity with the English twin: the same five cards, the open slot, the showcase bar in the lead and in the requirements, translated labels and descriptions.
